name: Liquid Image Hover
description: A WebGL image hover for React: the picture turns to water under the cursor. A real ripple simulation takes a trail of drops, and the image is refracted through it with a chromatic split, slope shading, highlights lit from the pointer and caustics. Splashes in on first view; rests when the water is flat. three.js.

props.name: src
props.description: The image (remote hosts need CORS). It fills the box like object-fit: cover.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How far the water bends the picture.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Colour split at the ripple edges.

props.name: shade
props.description: Light and shade on the slopes.

props.name: caustics
props.description: Bright caustic lines on the crests.

props.name: dropSize
props.description: Drop size, as a share of the image height.

props.name: entrySplash
props.description: Splash with a ring of drops when the image first comes into view; 0 turns it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a size.
